title: Analytical Research & Development (AR&D)
bodyHtml:
Analytical Research & Development (AR&D) Division firmly reinforces the mission and vision of IPC by bringing the highest standards of drugs by publication of the Indian Pharmacopoeia editions at regular intervals. The AR&D Division continuously promulgates changes to analytical test procedures in accordance with the latest technological requirements.

The Analytical R&D Division is engaged in following functions:

IP Development and Review

  • Monograph and General Chapters
  • The Division is actively engaged in the development of new monographs and general chapters, and the revision/upgradation of existing monographs of APIs, formulations, and excipients for the Indian Pharmacopoeia to ensure the quality control of drugs and medicines being marketed in India.
  • The Division also issues amendment lists, as and when required, based on feedback and suggestions from stakeholders and experts.
  • It acts as the IPC Secretariat, developing monographs and resolving queries by working closely with Marketing Authorization Holders (MAHs), other international pharmacopoeias, and stakeholders of the Indian Pharmacopoeia.
  • It coordinates meetings of various Expert Working Groups (EWGs) for the development and upgradation of the Indian Pharmacopoeia.
  • Method Development and Validation
  • It undertakes method development and validation of new methodologies or upgrades for the Indian Pharmacopoeia.

IP Online

  • Maintains and regularly updates the content of the IP Online.
  • Addressing user queries and providing timely support to stakeholders.

International Collaboration

  • The Division is actively involved in collaboration and harmonization activities as part of the PDG with other international pharmacopoeias (USP, EP, JP) and the WHO as Observer.
  • Bilateral collaborations with other pharmacopoeia bodies (like BP, USP, Russian Pharmacopoeia) on matters related to pharmaceutical standardization.
  • Facilitates global recognition of the Indian Pharmacopoeia (IP).

Trainings, Stakeholder Interactions & Other Activities

  • It imparts training to pharmacy graduates, postgraduates, and scientists to create awareness and build relevant skills.
  • Organising IPC Interactive Sessions with stakeholders for awareness of IP standards and their updates.
